_doc: B3 general scripted-expert test (REAL2SIM_CHECKLIST_V1 B3, B4, B5). Every number here is a choice, not a measurement; change it here, not in the script. Distances in m, times in s, angles in deg.
_approach_correct_doc: after the descend, re-aim on the measured fingertip error up to this many times (0 = make_tasks' open-loop expert)
_friction_doc: MuJoCo takes the larger sliding friction of the two touching geoms, so scaling only the object would do nothing while the pads are higher. 'object_and_pads' scales the object's geoms and the gripper pads' collision geoms by the same factor (table unchanged); the effective pad-object value is recorded.
